name: OmniShoutmon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon whose total DP adds up to 4000 or less and delete them. For every 2 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 3000 to the maximum you can choose with this effect.
[Your Turn] While this Digimon has 4 or more digivolution cards, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
